summary: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026 (US equivalent: an 8-K/earnings release, not a special situation) attaching its second-quarter and first-half 2026 results. Q2 revenue rose 29% year over year to $14.9 million, net income was $1.4 million or $0.19 per diluted share, backlog held at a record $31 million, and full-year net income guidance was raised above $3.6 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed.
